lcc_original: 上帝稱旱地爲地，稱水之積聚爲海：上帝看這很好。
notes: 上帝 (LCC) vs 神 (UNV) both = H0430 Elohim — straightforward lexical variant
之 before 積聚 is a Chinese genitive particle with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated; 積聚 carries WAH09001+WH04723 (מִקְוֵה miqveh)
{<WAH03588>} is implicit כִּי in UNV but LCC renders it explicitly as 這 ('this/that') — dropped braces per Rule 3
很好 annotated as a phrase with WH02896 (טוֹב); 很 is a Chinese intensifier with no Hebrew equivalent but inseparable from the headword 好 in LCC's rendering
